data.body:
[P2] Reject duplicate attempt ordinals within a role

Different request IDs can both declare `role: "victim", attempt: 1`, allowing the later request to satisfy the original-request check. The earlier request can remain in `attempts` with failed placement while only the selected replacement receives the placement assertions. Enforce unique `(role, attempt)` pairs so each role has one identifiable original request, and add a regression retaining a failed-placement original while selecting a duplicate ordinal-1 replacement.
